name: Strength of Will (Ki)
body:
The power of your mind allows you to resist harm to the body.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 13, ki pool class feature or Ki Meditation

Benefit(s): When targeted by an effect that requires a Fortitude or Reflex save, as an immediate action you can spend 2 points from your ki pool to replace the normal saving throw with a Will save.
